subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 Consolidation: Grammar file and speaking practice
outcomes: Choose between the present simple and present continuous.
Match time expressions with the right present tense.
Answer speaking questions with reasons and examples.

tf.s: 'Every day' is used with the present simple.
'This week' is used with the present continuous.
'At the moment' is used with the present simple.
tf.why: 'At the moment' goes with the present continuous.

tf.s: 'My mother isn't liking using a laptop' is correct.
'Do you like school? Yes, I do.' is a correct short answer.
tf.why: Short answers repeat the helping verb.

tf.s: 'Once a month' is used with the present continuous.
tf.why: 'Once a month' shows a habit, so we use the present simple.

tf.s: In the introduction speaking task, you should give reasons and examples.
'Are you chatting to your friends right now?' is correct.
Stative verbs like 'have' (own) are usually used in the continuous form.
tf.why: We say 'I don't have a car', not 'I'm not having a car'.

tf.s: You can use the grammar file to check and correct your own work.
tf.why: It is a great tool for learning alone.

boxes.why: 'At the moment' takes the present continuous.

mcq.q: Which time expressions go with the present continuous?
o: at the moment, now, this week, today
mcq.why: These show now or around now.

mcq.q: Which of these is a stative verb?
What is the grammar file useful for?
o: Checking rules and correcting your own work
mcq.why: Use it to check your grammar.

mcq.q: Which is a correct short answer?
mcq.why: Use the helping verb in short answers.

mcq.q: Answer with a reason: Do you prefer playing or watching sport?
o: I prefer playing sport because I like being active.
mcq.why: A good answer gives a reason.

mcq.q: Make a question: you / like / school?
Complete: I usually walk to school, but today I ___ the bus.
mcq.why: 'Today' is different from the habit, so we use the present continuous.

mcq.q: Why is 'doesn't like' correct in 'My mother doesn't like using a laptop'?
mcq.why: Stative verbs take the present simple.

mcq.q: Which pair shows a stative verb and an action verb used correctly?
o: I understand the lesson. I'm writing an email.
I'm understanding the lesson. I write an email now.
I understanding the lesson. I'm write an email.
I am understand the lesson. I writing an email.

mcq.q: What makes an answer in the introduction task good?
o: It gives a reason and an example.
It is all in the past tense.
mcq.why: Reasons and examples show your English well.
